newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM Aug, Oct, Dec platinum surge by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM Aug, Oct, Dec platinum surge by daily limit.

text.p: Yen-based August, October and December platinum futures on TOCOM surged by their 50 yen per gram daily limit in early afternoon trade on Monday on heavy short-covering, traders said.

"The surge in spot platinum prices last Friday caused by worries over the protracted suspension of Russian sales, forced private investors to cover their short-positions today," a commodity brokerage analyst said. "Strength in spot June (which has no daily limit) spilled over to other nearby contracts."
Benchmark April platinum was up four yen at 1,388 yen.

Traders said the market was likely to remain tense for some time. "Even if Russia were to resume exports in late June, it would take some time for the market to return to normal," one trader said. He said the backwardation suggested that platinum prices would be lower later this year.
